title: Lost Access Code
scenario: A friend asks for a 2FA code because their student email is locked.

answers.A: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.B: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.C: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.
answers.D: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.

explanation: Lost Access Code: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Verification codes prove possession and should never be shared.
